faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Whoever you choose when you post: just you, your group, your community, or everyone. Audience is a choice you make per post — it's not a global setting.
faq.q2: Where do announcements like water cuts and roadworks live?
faq.a2_outro: — the read side is open so nobody has to log in to find out when the street gets repainted.
faq.a3: Yes. Every time someone is allowed (or denied) access to restricted content, it's recorded. The data stays on a single database owned by the neighbourhood's host, and there are no ads or tracking built in.
